syscalls.name: SYS_exit
syscalls.behavior: Transitions calling process to SZOMB, records exit status, wakes parent or reaps

syscalls.name: SYS_write
syscalls.behavior: Validates fd table, validates user buffer memory via validate_user_buffer, copies out to virtual console/pipe, returns bytes written

syscalls.name: SYS_getpid
syscalls.behavior: Returns current process PID in X0

syscalls.name: SYS_mach_msg_trap
syscalls.behavior: Validates message header, delivers message to target port in process IPC space or queues for reception
syscalls.return: MACH_MSG_SUCCESS (0) or Mach IPC error code

syscalls.name: SYS_getppid
syscalls.behavior: Returns parent process PID in X0

syscalls.name: SYS_sched_yield
syscalls.behavior: Voluntarily yields remaining thread quantum in scheduler and picks next thread
